name: Long-Term Resident EU Permit (Daueraufenthalt -- EU)

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of uninterrupted legal residence in Austria under an eligible permit (e.g. Red-White-Red Card, EU Blue Card, Settlement Permit).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of uninterrupted legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: B1-level German proficiency, demonstrated via the OeIF Integration Exam Certificate (exemptions/substitutions for children).
requirements.fix_path: Pass the OeIF Integration Exam at B1 level.

requirements.blocker_text: Sufficient financial means and continuous health insurance coverage over the 5-year period must be shown.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' uninterrupted legal residence
Proof of financial means and continuous health insurance

outcome.duration_length: permit card valid 5 years, but underlying residence status is indefinite as long as continuous Austrian residence continues

sources.title: workinaustria.com (AMS/ABA-run official relocation portal) -- Long-Term Resident EU permit: 5-year residence requirement, B1 German via OeIF exam, financial means/insurance, EUR 275 fee, unrestricted labour-market access, 5-year card validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria). citizenship_after_months (120) mirrors at_naturalisation.json's standard 10-year track since holding this status does not itself shorten the naturalisation clock under the sources reviewed. Card must be renewed every 5 years but the underlying residence right does not expire, distinguishing it from a fixed-term permit.
